DEC-054.row: | DEC-054 | 2026-09-16 | **Q4: the loss-level κ pilot goes** (lead, relaying Matthew Ikle's review of the pivot and counter-review: "makes a lot of sense ... relatively on the cheap ... we need to be upfront about our conclusion as is mentioned in the counter-review under section 4 'What it is not' — our results are preliminary hints"). Arms and aggregation as in `kappa_pilot_v2.json` (ordinary κ = 0; κ = 0.2; κ = 0.5; clipped surprisal at 2, three seeds each); the ordinary arm is the v5 candidate family reused, not retrained; final checkpoint = the predeclared 150–300 average; decision rule from the counter-review §4 (declared secondary condition only if mean RET-GS drops ≤ 0.02, unseen false fires do not rise, and one pre-registered tail statistic moves by more than its seed spread; otherwise a null result, still reported). **Framing binding:** every report of the κ result carries the §4 "What it is not" statement — preliminary hints at what the architecture could provide, not the coupled free energy, not a test of the one-κ conjecture. | `manifests/revision_v1/kappa_pilot_v3.json`; `docs/heavy_tail_counter_review.md` §4; `docs/lead_queue.md` Q4. | Lead decision with reviewer concurrence; launched 2026-09-16 10:30 EDT, ≈ 6 GPU h measured budget (the v2 3 h figure omitted evaluation). |

DEC-055.row: | DEC-055 | 2026-09-16 | **Q5: the stress panel goes** (lead: "Q5 decision is go"): the six HT-2 development cells (`manifests/revision_v1/ht_development_panel_v1.json`: zsRE / CounterFact / MQuAKE × shuffled / clustered, seed 303, 100 attempted edits, probes at 20 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 100, old-fact recovery on 20 fixed probes) on the selected primary v5, within the 4 GPU-hour ceiling, charged in full including failures; development only, never confirmatory; scheduled after the comparator profiles and the MQuAKE calibration (chain I), before the confirmatory launch. | `docs/heavy_tail_counter_review.md` §2; `docs/tasks/HT-2.md`, `HT-5.md`; `docs/lead_queue.md` Q5. | Lead decision. Reader binding and recipe construction through Codex's HT-5 driver are the orchestrator's next steps. |

DEC-056.row: | DEC-056 | 2026-09-16 | **Q10: option B** (lead: "Q10 B"): a bounded alias / context / role review of the 700 historically primary-exposed MQuAKE rows (old v2 training pool + legacy development, minus the selected reader's training items and exact query overlaps), then a versioned 100 / 300-record common-outside occupancy diagnostic on MQuAKE with the 1,000-record point explicitly absent; no final-register headroom is spent; the rows are labelled as new to the selected reader's training but historically exposed elsewhere. | `docs/tasks/R1-76-mquake-occupancy.md`; `docs/lead_queue.md` Q10. | Lead decision. Codex reviews and versions the population (lane R1-76b); the orchestrator runs it (≈ 1 GPU h). |

DEC-057.row: | DEC-057 | 2026-09-16 | **Q11 (U12) accepted as proposed**: all seven primary-vs-control comparisons retained separately per dataset (21 contrast / dataset claims at checkpoint 1,000; controls R1_nonlearned, v0_stable, matched_update, v0_live_C1, v0_live_C2, S1_LM, S1_literal); one family of 63 metric intervals (21 × RET-GS / ES / LS) with a nominal Bonferroni budget of 0.05 (two-sided confidence 1 − 0.05/63); the existing realization-cluster bootstrap (float64, seed 0, 10,000 draws, NumPy linear percentiles, three fresh realization means resampled with the five paired orders kept inside each realization); only complete paired populations enter; no imputation. Reported with the caveat that three clusters make these intervals nominal, and with all three realization estimates and the unadjusted 97.5 % interval alongside. | `docs/tasks/R1-49f-lead-bindings.md` §Q11; `docs/lead_queue.md` Q11. | Lead decision. Bound into protocol v5 §U12 and the R1-75 analysis tree. |

DEC-058.row: | DEC-058 | 2026-09-16 | **Q12 (U13) accepted as proposed**: DEC-033 margins kept (RET-GS +0.05, ES −0.02, LS −0.01, LS under DEC-053 bounded equality) with the four-way classifier bound exactly: unavailable (incomplete required population / admissibility); negative if U_G < 0.05 or U_E < −0.02 or U_L < −0.01 (priority); positive if ΔG ≥ 0.05 and L_G > 0 and L_E > −0.02 and L_L > −0.01; qualified if not negative, ΔG ≥ 0.05, L_G > 0, ΔE ≥ −0.02, ΔL ≥ −0.01 while a preservation lower-bound test fails; inconclusive otherwise; strict inequalities on margins as stated; intervals from the DEC-057 family. | `docs/tasks/R1-49f-lead-bindings.md` §Q12; `docs/lead_queue.md` Q12. | Lead decision. Protocol v5 §U13; R1-75. |

DEC-059.row: | DEC-059 | 2026-09-16 | **Q13 (U14) accepted as proposed**: secondary descriptive pass / fail benchmarks with fixed denominators and reported uncertainty, outside the primary classifier and without a simultaneous error guarantee: unseen false-fire rate at actual occupancy 1,000 ≤ 0.15 (a deployment tolerance, distinct from DEC-050's 0.10 selection gate); common-outside occupancy change F1000 − F100 inside ±0.05 (equivalence claims need the paired 95 % interval inside ±0.05; unavailable without actual occupancy); latest revision success ≥ 0.95 (≥ 48/50); old-alias reappearance ≤ 0.02 (≤ 1/50); supported semantic revision ≥ 0.95; RET-GS change 100 → 1,000 ≥ −0.05; ES / bounded LS changes ≥ −0.02 / −0.01; state bytes, peak memory and wall time within the September 20 admitted ceilings; cells and macro summaries both shown; composition descriptive. | `docs/tasks/R1-49f-lead-bindings.md` §Q13; `docs/lead_queue.md` Q13. | Lead decision. Protocol v5 §U14; R1-75. |

DEC-060.row: | DEC-060 | 2026-09-17 | **Q14: option D** (lead): the quarantined MQuAKE context matches are adjudicated first under an outcome-independent rule (Codex lane R1-D10e; orchestrator review; both evidence versions hash-bound), and MQuAKE then runs under option A's structure — 300 edits per realization, three realizations, checkpoints 100 / 300, demand 1,950 subjects — with whatever margin the review restores; MQuAKE's 1,000-record claims are reported as unavailable. If the reviewed capacity would support a larger MQuAKE edit count under the same three-realization structure, that is brought back as a question, not applied. zsRE and CounterFact are unaffected. | `docs/tasks/R1-D10a.md`; `logs/r1_round22/r1-d10a-capacity-diagnostics-v2.json`; `docs/lead_queue.md` Q14. | Lead decision. Matrix / protocol v5.2 deltas from R1-D10d (option A) after the R1-D10e review. |
